The campaign archive / Teen Soirée selected from seven chapters

Overview

A campaign archive for independent nights in Agra. One browsing system gives seven distinct event identities room to lead.

What I focused on

A campaign selector that keeps each poster and its details in sync
A locally rendered Three.js sculpture, with a still fallback
Seven event pages built from supplied artwork and confirmed details

How it came together

The supplied posters set the visual direction. The two HEAT homepage captures show different layouts for the same campaign: one pairs the poster with a sculpture; the other makes the artwork dominant. The archive keeps the selected poster and its event details together.

Featured campaign within TEEN FIESTA

RED ROOM

31 October 2026 / Mansion, Agra

The featured Teen Fiesta event campaign. Its announcement, event details and artwork are presented within the Teen Fiesta website, alongside imagery from earlier campaigns.

Overview

One Teen Fiesta website, led by the RED ROOM campaign. Its event page brings together the announcement, event information, gallery and film.

What I focused on

A custom swept-metal form built from Three.js geometry
A campaign gallery with keyboard and touch controls
An event pass preview that is clearly labeled as a preview

How it came together

The page begins with the red campaign world, then moves into practical event information. Native video controls, mobile-specific composition, and a still 3D fallback keep the atmosphere usable across devices.
